cross-tenant-invoice-read.title: Cross-tenant invoice read (IDOR / broken object-level authorization)
cross-tenant-invoice-read.missingControl: The handler checks that the caller is authenticated but never compares invoice.accountId with the caller's account, so any signed-in user can read any tenant's invoice.
cross-tenant-invoice-read.provenance: Stored remediation, written by hand for this demo. It was NOT generated by a model or derived automatically from the finding. Locating the code is automated; proposing the fix is not.
